AIXBT.label: bearish
AIXBT.about: aixbt is an autonomous AI agent launched on Virtuals Protocol that tracks crypto social chatter and market data and posts market intelligence. Holding AIXBT gives access to its premium analytics terminal.
AIXBT.summary: No price-moving news in the past week and supply is fully unlocked, so no new supply pressure. Liquidity stays thin after Binance removed margin and a spot pair in September.

TRUMP.label: bearish
TRUMP.about: Official Trump is a Solana memecoin tied to Donald Trump; Trump-linked entities hold about 80% of supply under multi-year vesting. It has no utility beyond speculation and holder perks such as dinner events.
TRUMP.summary: The post-midterm drop and an insider unlock listed for Nov 18 lean toward the short; a holder-dinner snapshot on Nov 12 could support holding demand until then.

news.title: TRUMP falls about 17% after the Democratic midterm sweep hits Trump-linked assets

unlocks.note: Monthly insider unlock (2.9% of total supply, ~3.7% of market cap); one source only, DropsTab models it as daily linear vesting

DASH.label: bullish
DASH.about: Dash is a proof-of-work digital cash coin with masternodes, instant transactions and optional mixing, plus the Evolution app platform. DASH is used for payments, fees and masternode collateral.
DASH.summary: The v24 release and signaling from Nov 9 set up a dated catalyst (shared masternodes around Nov 28) that supports the long, while the EU privacy-coin rules from 2027 remain a drag. Mined coin with no unlocks.

news.title: Dash Core v24.0.0 released; every node must upgrade ahead of the masternode-shares hard fork
v24 hard fork targeted for about Nov 28 lets users pool the 1,000 DASH masternode collateral; signaling begins Nov 9
Privacy coins sell off and DASH slips to about $46 on worries over the EU privacy-coin ban

PUMP.label: bullish
PUMP.about: Pump.fun is a Solana launchpad and trading platform for memecoins. PUMP is its native token, and the protocol uses part of its revenue to buy back and burn PUMP.
PUMP.summary: Weekly buybacks (~$5M) continue, but about 9B PUMP from the monthly team/investor unlock lands Nov 12, and Pump.fun is still sending SOL to Kraken. Together they add supply pressure against the long.

news.title: Pump.fun brings in about $56M in 30-day revenue and has spent about $414M on PUMP buybacks and burns in 2026
Pump.fun moves 76,111 SOL (~$6.9M) to Kraken during a market-wide sell-off
About $5M of PUMP bought back and burned over the past week

unlocks.note: Monthly linear release to team/insiders (~61%) and existing investors (~39%), about 0.9% of total supply. DropsTab shows ~8.96B PUMP (about 1.95% of circulating) for the next tranche but gives no date

NXPC.label: bearish
NXPC.about: NEXPACE is Nexon's Web3 arm behind MapleStory Universe, running on the Henesys chain (an Avalanche L1). NXPC is used for item minting and enhancement, marketplace fees and rewards, with 20% of user-activity revenue burned quarterly.
NXPC.summary: Nexpace's Nov 9 revision is a large supply cut: about 95.7M NXPC (roughly 30% of circulating) to be burned in December, weekly Contribution Reward releases burned for at least 52 weeks, and Reactor shut down, which works against the short. The Nov 15 unlock still adds supply before the burns take effect in December, so it is the main near-term support for the short.

news.title: Nexpace revises NXPC whitepaper, halting new Contribution Reward emissions
Nexpace to burn 95.7M NXPC (about 30% of circulating) in December and close Reactor

unlocks.note: Foundation/Contribution Reward (~97%) and insiders (~3%) per Tokenomics.com, ~2.4% of market cap. Date confirmed by Tokenomist (IP MG and Team cliff) and CoinGecko, which lists only the 0.99M IP MG + Team cliff portion; the rest is reward emissions. Burning of weekly rewards starts only in December

MEME.label: bearish
MEME.about: Memecoin (MEME) is the token of Memeland, the Web3 group behind 9GAG's Captainz and Potatoz NFTs. It openly has no utility or roadmap and is used for community and ecosystem rewards.
MEME.summary: The only news is a small StockFi integration with unproven impact, and no dated unlock falls in Nov 8-22. The short mostly depends on broader memecoin risk appetite.

news.title: BSC platform StockFi plans to use MEME for community incentives around tokenized US stock trading

STABLE.label: bearish
STABLE.about: Stable is a Bitfinex/Tether-backed EVM Layer-1 built for stablecoin payments, using USDT0 as its gas asset. STABLE is the native token used for validator staking, governance and ecosystem incentives. The Hyperliquid STABLE perp launched Dec 8, 2025, alongside this chain's mainnet and token launch.
STABLE.summary: About 888.9M STABLE (~4.9% of circulating supply, ~$23-24M) unlocks for the community/ecosystem allocation on Nov 8, right after a rally that analysts flagged as overextended. That supply leans with the short, though recipients may stake rather than sell.

news.title: Stable activates mainnet v1.9.0 with security hardening and reliability upgrades
RootData flags a ~$23M STABLE unlock due Nov 8

unlocks.note: Community/ecosystem allocation (grants, liquidity, incentives); ~$23.8M, 3.3% of market cap; RootData gives 13:00 Beijing (05:00 UTC). % of circulating is from CMC AI.

WLFI.label: bearish
WLFI.about: World Liberty Financial is a Trump-family-linked DeFi and stablecoin project that issues the USD1 stablecoin. WLFI is its governance token.
WLFI.summary: WLFI sold off after the US midterms (down about 70% from its yearly high) on expected Democratic oversight of Trump-linked crypto. On Nov 6 the project announced a buyback but gave no size or timeline, a possible squeeze risk for shorts. Tracked insider unlocks remain in a cliff, so none are dated in the window.

news.title: World Liberty announces WLFI buyback after post-midterm drop; size and timeline not disclosed, partly funded by USD1 reserve fees
Rep. Maxine Waters calls for stricter crypto rules targeting Trump-linked projects as the House Oversight probe looms

HMSTR.label: bearish
HMSTR.about: Hamster Kombat is a tap-to-earn Telegram game on TON that grew from a viral clicker into a wider gaming ecosystem. HMSTR is its token, distributed through player airdrops and used for rewards and in-game activity.
HMSTR.summary: No price-moving HMSTR news this week; coverage only notes it trades about 97% below its listing-day peak. The next scheduled unlock (about 347M HMSTR, insiders and foundation) is Nov 26, just after the window, so price tracks Telegram-game and memecoin sentiment for now.

TNSR.label: bearish
TNSR.about: Tensor is a pro-trader NFT marketplace on Solana run by the Tensor Foundation. TNSR is its governance token, and marketplace fees flow to the TNSR treasury.
TNSR.summary: Coinbase suspended TNSR trading on Nov 9, adding to thin liquidity after Binance dropped its TNSR/USDC pair in September. Tokenomist shows no cliff unlock scheduled through Nov 25; only small linear vesting continues.

news.title: Coinbase suspends TNSR (and BAL) trading on Nov 9 after a listing review; order books already limit-only

ZEC.label: bullish
ZEC.about: Zcash is a privacy-focused proof-of-work cryptocurrency that supports shielded (encrypted) transactions using zero-knowledge proofs. ZEC is used for payments and paying fees, and is mined with a fixed 21M supply cap.
ZEC.summary: ZEC fell about 10.5% on Nov 10 to below $1,100, with its Grayscale ETF seeing outflows and most large longs underwater, so the post-NU7 selloff works against the long; Grayscale's $1M ecosystem pledge has not stopped the drop. It is a mined coin, so there are no unlocks.

news.title: Grayscale pledges $1M to Zcash ecosystem support and runs an ad campaign as ZEC and its ETF fall about 12%
ZEC slides 10.5% in a day to under $1,100, the worst of the majors; about 31% below its late-September level
Developers propose cutting block time again to 20 seconds in a future NU7.1 upgrade

VVV.label: bullish
VVV.about: Venice is a privacy-first AI platform offering private, uncensored access to text, image and code models via app and API. Staking VVV gives a share of free API inference capacity, and part of supply is burned.
VVV.summary: The record Nov 9 burn is a plus, but monthly emissions (about 167K VVV) still outweigh it, and VVV fell about 8% on Nov 10, more than the market, leaving it down roughly 13% for the week near the watched $19 support. No unlock is due in the window.

news.title: Venice burns a record 21,657 VVV (about $458K) in its monthly buyback, about 10% more than October
VVV drops about 8% in a day, roughly four times the market's fall, with no coin-specific trigger found
Valour lists a Venice (VVV) exchange-traded product on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market

LIT.label: bullish
LIT.about: Lighter is a perpetual-futures DEX built on an Ethereum zk-rollup with verifiable order matching, also offering stock perps. LIT is its native token, used for governance and staking, with protocol revenue funding buybacks.
LIT.summary: Rising protocol revenue that funds buybacks and the planned November CFTC filing support the long, but there is no new catalyst this week and no confirmed filing yet in a weak market. No unlock in the window; the large team and investor cliff starts Dec 27.

news.title: LIT rebounds about 5% on strong daily revenue and short covering; weekly fees up about 18%

XMR.label: bullish
XMR.about: Monero is a privacy-focused proof-of-work cryptocurrency where sender, receiver and amount are hidden by default. XMR is used for private payments and has a small perpetual tail emission.
XMR.summary: XMR dropped about 9% on Nov 10 with the wider market, though it is still one of 2026's stronger large caps; regulators treating privacy coins separately (Korea custody, EU 2027 rules) keeps headline risk on. It is mined, so there are no unlocks.

news.title: XMR falls about 9% in a day alongside ZEC as privacy coins lead the market's losses
South Korean police move seized crypto to Upbit Custody but exclude Monero, which stays in separate cold wallets
Analysis: XMR is up about 73% in 2026, but EU anti-money-laundering rules bar regulated platforms from privacy coins from July 2027

HYPE.label: bullish
HYPE.about: Hyperliquid is a layer-1 chain built around an on-chain perpetual futures and spot exchange. HYPE pays gas, is staked for security and to deploy HIP-3 markets, and receives buybacks from trading fees.
HYPE.summary: HYPE was listed on both Upbit and Bithumb on Nov 10, opening Korean won access and drawing about $220M of 24-hour volume on Bithumb, and Elysium went live with HYPE as gas; both support the long, though HYPE is still down about 16% on the week in a weak market. No unlock is due before early December.

news.title: Upbit and Bithumb list HYPE on Nov 10 with KRW, BTC and USDT pairs; HYPE takes about 35% of Bithumb's daily turnover
Uniswap v2, v3 and v4 go live on Elysium, the HYPE-gas layer 2 whose public mainnet launched on Nov 9
Glassnode: Hyperliquid whales turn net short on BTC for the first time in seven months

FOGO.label: bearish
FOGO.about: Fogo is a Solana-VM-compatible Layer-1 built for low-latency on-chain trading. FOGO pays gas, is staked to secure the network and funds ecosystem incentives.
FOGO.summary: Bitget's spot delisting (effective Nov 6) has thinned liquidity. tokenomics.com shows a 171.5M FOGO insider/investor unlock on Nov 15 (about 4.3% of market cap), while Tokenomist puts the next cliff on Nov 26, so new supply is due either way, which fits the short.

news.title: Bitget delisting of the FOGO/USDT spot pair takes effect

unlocks.note: Insiders (~66%) and private investors (~34%), about 1.7% of total supply and 4.3% of market cap per tokenomics.com. Tokenomist instead shows the next unlock (core contributors, Echo raise, institutional investors, advisors) on Nov 26, so the date is uncertain.

SOPH.label: bearish
SOPH.about: Sophon was a consumer-focused Ethereum L2 built on ZKsync tech that is shutting its chain to focus on apps on Base. SOPH was its gas, staking and governance token and is migrating to an Ethereum ERC-20.
SOPH.summary: No new news this week, and the wind-down stands: Upbit ends SOPH trading Nov 16, withdrawals close Nov 25 and mainnet shuts Nov 30. No unlock falls in the window, and the shutdown overhang still fits the short.

2Z.label: bearish
2Z.about: DoubleZero is a high-performance fiber network for Solana and other chains' validators, aimed at cutting latency and bandwidth costs. 2Z pays for network access and rewards bandwidth contributors.
2Z.summary: Searches turned up no price-moving 2Z news from the last 7 days, and no unlock falls between Nov 12 and Nov 26. The next tranche (about 135.4M 2Z on Dec 2, per the previous check) is outside the window, so nothing here adds to or against the short for now.

BLUR.label: bearish
BLUR.about: Blur is a pro-trader NFT marketplace and aggregator on Ethereum that also ran Blend, a peer-to-peer NFT lending product. BLUR is its governance token and controls the fee switch.
BLUR.summary: The blur.io front end and new Blend loans shut down today (Nov 12). About 40.4M BLUR unlocks on Nov 14 for insiders, investors and the foundation, and Upbit stops trading BLUR on Nov 30. Shrinking use, new supply and thinner Korean liquidity all fit the short.

unlocks.note: Insiders (~47%), private investors (~29%) and foundation (~24%); about 1.3% of total supply and 1.5% of market cap per tracker

JTO.label: bearish
JTO.about: Jito is Solana's largest liquid-staking and MEV infrastructure project (JitoSOL, the Jito block engine and the Block Assembly Marketplace). JTO is its governance token, with JTX platform revenue going to buybacks and burns under JIP-38.
JTO.summary: No JTO unlock is due in the window; scheduled vesting wrapped up around Nov 7. New revenue sources (JTX equities, where 80% of fees fund JTO buybacks, and BAM selling early trade data) work against the short, though tokens unlocked recently could still be sold.

news.title: Jito's BAM starts selling early pre-confirmation trade data, with revenue shared with validators and the Jito DAO
JTX launches RFQ trading for 1,650+ tokenized stocks; 80% of fees go to JTO buybacks
Formation Securities files with the SEC for a Solana tokenized-stock venue, naming JTX as a distribution partner

KAITO.label: bearish
KAITO.about: Kaito is an AI-driven crypto research and InfoFi platform that ranks social attention and links brands with creators. KAITO is used for staking, governance and access to platform rewards.
KAITO.summary: The main supply event is the Nov 20 monthly unlock of about 27.2M KAITO (about 2.7% of total supply), which suits the short. MEXC also drops its KAITO USDC-margined perp today (Nov 12), a small cut to derivatives liquidity, and no offsetting positive news turned up.

news.title: MEXC delists KAITO USDC-margined perpetual (one of 14 pairs), effective Nov 12

unlocks.note: Monthly unlock (2.7% of total supply, ~5.4% of market cap): community/ecosystem ~61.5%, core contributors ~25.6%, early backers ~8.5%, foundation ~4.5%. Tokenomist also lists Nov 20 as the next unlock (core contributors).

HEMI.label: bearish
HEMI.about: Hemi is a modular Layer-2 that joins Bitcoin and Ethereum, anchoring state to Bitcoin so developers can build BTC DeFi with EVM tools. HEMI pays network fees and is staked as veHEMI for governance and yield.
HEMI.summary: Still no price-moving HEMI news this week and no unlock before Nov 26. The next monthly tranche (341.2M HEMI) lands Nov 29, just outside the window, so for now the short depends on the chart.

ME.label: bearish
ME.about: Magic Eden is an NFT and token trading platform that in 2026 closed its Bitcoin and EVM marketplaces to focus on Solana and 'crypto entertainment'. ME is its governance and rewards token, with 15% of platform revenue going to buybacks and staker rewards.
ME.summary: Liquidity is thinner since the OKX spot delisting (Nov 5), and the Nov 10 unlock (6.96M ME) is now circulating. No more unlocks before Nov 26, so revenue-funded buybacks are the main offset to the short.

news.title: OKX delists ME spot pairs and suspends deposits, effective Nov 5

XPL.label: bearish
XPL.about: Plasma is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 built for stablecoin payments, offering zero-fee USDT transfers and anchoring to Bitcoin. XPL is the native token used for gas, validator staking and network rewards.
XPL.summary: XPL is near record lows (~$0.056). Binance is expected to reopen Plasma withdrawals around Nov 14-15, which could release trapped sell flow, and the Nov 25 unlock (~232M XPL) adds supply. Both favour the short, but the downside may be stretched at record lows.

news.title: Binance plans to reopen withdrawals for six tokens, including Plasma, before the Nov 14-15 weekend
Binance reopens HYPE and APT withdrawals; Plasma still waiting in the same post-hack phase
XPL among 26 tokens printing new all-time lows, trading around $0.056

unlocks.note: Monthly vesting (2.3% of total supply, ~4.9% of market cap): community ~38%, private investors ~32%, insiders ~30%. Tokenomist and CoinMarketCal also list Nov 25.

BERA.label: bearish
BERA.about: Berachain is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 using Proof-of-Liquidity, where validators direct rewards to liquidity providers. BERA is the gas and staking token, while BGT handles governance and reward emissions.
BERA.summary: No price-moving Berachain news this week and no unlock until Dec 6 (13.4M BERA, outside the window). The short has no fresh catalyst beyond the chart and the broader market.

BOME.label: bearish
BOME.about: BOOK OF MEME is a Solana memecoin themed around permanently storing meme culture on decentralized storage. BOME has no real utility and trades on speculation and community attention.
BOME.summary: No BOME-specific news in the past week and the supply is fully circulating, so there are no unlocks. Price follows broad memecoin sentiment and leverage flushes.

BANANA.label: bearish
BANANA.about: Banana Gun is a trading-bot platform (Telegram and web) for sniping and fast swaps across Ethereum, Solana, Base and other chains. BANANA is its token, and holders receive a share of bot fee revenue.
BANANA.summary: No BANANA-specific news in the past week and no dated unlock found for Nov 12-26. Price trades on trading-bot volumes and broad market sentiment; the token is down about 26% over 30 days.

HYPER.label: bearish
HYPER.about: Hyperlane is a permissionless interoperability protocol that lets apps send messages and bridge tokens (Warp Routes) across 150+ chains, including EVM, Solana and Cosmos networks. HYPER is used for staking to secure the network, governance, and rewards for users and chains that expand its use.
HYPER.summary: No price-moving Hyperlane news in the past week. The monthly Nov 22 unlock (about 22.3M HYPER, roughly 5.7% of market cap, mostly insiders and private investors) adds supply that favours the short.

unlocks.note: Monthly vesting: insiders/core team ~47%, community rewards ~22%, private investors ~20%, foundation ~11%; ~2.2% of total supply, ~5.7% of market cap per Tokenomics.com. DropsTab shows the team, early-backer and foundation tranches (13.5M) due on the same timing

APE.label: bearish
APE.about: ApeCoin is the governance and utility token of the ApeCoin DAO and the Bored Ape Yacht Club / Yuga Labs ecosystem. It also pays gas on ApeChain, an Arbitrum-based chain for NFT, gaming and culture apps.
APE.summary: No price-moving news this week; the latest item is ApeChain switching its bridging to Chainlink CCIP, announced Nov 4. Tokenomist shows APE as fully unlocked, so no new supply is coming, and the short rests on the chart alone.

PEOPLE.label: bearish
PEOPLE.about: ConstitutionDAO began as a 2021 crowdfund that tried to buy a first-edition copy of the US Constitution. PEOPLE was its governance token and now trades as a fully circulating community memecoin with no active product.
PEOPLE.summary: No project news or unlocks, and the supply is fully circulating. With the midterm political catalyst behind it, price trades on memecoin sentiment.
